However, for TTS, it requires LIVE operations to quickly onboard and educate merchants to start selling on TTS, the product team to build the end-to-end bidding product flow, and XFN to complete the development of ecosystem rules and governance requirements for merchant and user bidding. This project targets GMV growth for LIVE auction. Teams including Operations, Product, R&D, GNE,  Logistics, Algo, UG, User Research and Strategy worked together, essentially building the entire auction business and product model from scratch. With highly coordinated, focused and efficient internal collaboration, the project quickly delivered breakthroughs in the auction business.
In terms of final results, the rapid growth of LIVE GMV in H1 2026 drove the overall growth of TTS US: Daily Avg. GMV of LIVE increased from 6,802K in January to 15,466K in June (+ 127%), exceeding the H1 target. The share of LIVE GMV rose from 13% in January to 20.9% in June. The relative share of TTS / Whatnot caught up rapidly, from 26% in January to 51.3% in June. The growth of LIVE GMV was mainly driven by auction GMV, which contributed 89% of the LIVE GMV increment; the Daily Avg. GMV of auctions surged from 399K in January to 8,078K in June (+ 1923%).

SEA LIVE Ads delivered exceptional business growth in H1, with overall LIVE Take Rate increasing from 3.6% to 4.8%, while Merchant LIVE Take Rate grew even faster from 5.9% to 8.0%. Unlike traditional eCommerce ads, LIVE commerce requires fundamentally different solutions across advertiser adoption, customer behavior, traffic allocation, and monetization optimization due to its highly dynamic and real-time nature.
This growth was driven by four strategic pillars jointly delivered by the e-Commerce and Shop Ads organizations.
1. expanded LIVE GMax penetration through a combination of product innovation and ecosystem collaboration. Initiatives including Dynamic Commissions, LIVE Bundle, LIVE Mission, and joint key-account penetration programs with eCommerce Operations enabled substantially more merchants to adopt LIVE advertising at scale.
2. successfully transformed advertiser behavior to improve campaign quality and budget efficiency. Through Auto-Budget adoption, Creative Exploration optimization, and LIVE Ads Diagnosis enhancements, budget hit rates decreased from 30% to 25%, increased Video-to-LIVE creative supply among top advertisers, and extended LIVE advertising duration, creating a healthier and more sustainable monetization model.
3. maximized major commerce moments by launching programs such as the KLS Accelerator Program, enabling top advertisers to capitalize on Double Day and Payday campaigns with significant LIVE GMV acceleration during peak shopping events.
4. continuously optimized monetization efficiency through bidding strategy upgrades, automation capabilities, traffic allocation improvements, and Hybrid Lift optimization, further improving delivery efficiency and Take Rate.
Together, these initiatives addressed critical bottlenecks across the entire LIVE advertising ecosystem, from merchant activation and campaign adoption to traffic optimization and monetization efficiency, creating a scalable growth engine for LIVE Ads. Beyond delivering substantial Take Rate improvements in H1, the program established a stronger long-term foundation for sustainable LIVE commerce growth across global markets.
